name: Shark Bait: Riptide
source:
A life's debt must be paid... Can you uncover the weaknesses of the Gods to clear it? Or will you choose to side with them instead?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
欠下的一条命，终究要还…你能找出众神的弱点，偿清这笔债吗？还是会转而选择站到他们那边？
